title: Te Kaiwhakaputa o te Mātauranga Mutunga Kore
intro: He tangata whakaute, e mōhiotia ana mō ōna māramatanga hohonu me ōna tohutohu mohio, i mua i te wā i tuku tohutohu ai ia i tua atu i ngā whakatipuranga. Ko ā rātou kupu, kua tuhia ki roto i ngā karaipiture tapu, e ārahi ana i te tangata ki te whakawhetai, ki te manawanui, me te whanonga tika.
clues: I manaakitia ahau ki te whakaaro nui, ehara i te poropititanga.
I tohutohu ahau i taku tamaiti mō te hara nui rawa atu: te whakahoa ki a Allah.
I whakaako ahau i te taumaha o ngā mahi, tae noa ki te taumaha o te purapura sinapi, me te pēhea e whakaputaina ai e Allah.
I whakanuia e au te whakawhetai ki a Allah me ngā mātua, me te whakaae ki ngā uauatanga o te whakatipu tamariki.
Ko tāku i tohutohu ai ko te whakatū i te inoi, te whakahau i te pai, te aukati i te kino, me te manawanui ki ngā mea e pā mai ana ki te tangata.
Kua tapaina tētahi upoko o te Quran ki tōku ingoa, kei roto nei aku whakaakoranga me ngā akoranga i tohaina e au.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
